title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: cassette > Yamaha KX-W282 > Monster digital cable > Yamaha RX-530 > Monster digital cable > JVC XL-R5000 > CDR > EAC (offsets set) > CDWav > Flac (level 8)

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard out‑take featuring a transcendent Other One and Viola Lee Blues, with a tuneless but beloved Cold Rain & Snow, presented in generally good audio quality.
ai_review.review: The DP 8 out‑take from the May 2 1970 Harpur College show captures one of the band’s most celebrated moments – an explosive Other One followed by a soaring Viola Lee Blues and several other classics. While the recording is a decent soundboard source (though some listeners note mono quirks), the performance suffers from a noticeable out‑of‑tune Cold Rain & Snow, which divides opinion but adds to the historic charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars praising the musical highlights; a few note tuning problems and recording quirks, resulting in an overall strong but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard mix; some listeners mention mono electric set and advise EQ adjustments. No major drop‑outs, but tonal balance can benefit from user EQ.

poor_songs: Cold Rain and Snow (out of tune)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Single‑song out‑take, but reviewers treat it as a highlight from the full show; they lament missing tracks on DP 8 yet celebrate the energy and improvisational peaks of the included material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Out‑of‑tune issues likely due to his Gibson SG neck giving way; some describe a literal 'tuning up' at the start, but overall his solo work on Other One is praised.
